clock: a clock face with two hands and a circular arrow wrapping around it (auto-delete after a time)
code: two angle brackets < > with a forward slash between them (source code)
mic: a studio microphone capsule on a short stand
accessibility: a person figure with arms stretched out inside a circle (accessibility symbol)
waveform: five vertical rounded bars of different heights forming an audio waveform, tallest in the middle
waveform-circle: a filled black circle with a white audio waveform of five vertical rounded bars cut out of it
book: a closed book seen from the front cover, with a bookmark ribbon
check-circle: a filled black circle with a white checkmark cut out of it
x-circle: a filled black circle with a white X cross cut out of it
keyboard: a computer keyboard seen from above, rounded rectangle with rows of key dots and a space bar
text-lines: four horizontal lines of different lengths, left aligned, like paragraph text
sparkles: one large four-pointed sparkle star with a smaller one at its upper right
menubar: a rounded rectangle screen with a thin bar across the top and a small dot in the top right of that bar (menu bar)
hand: an open raised hand, palm facing forward
gear: a settings gear cog with eight teeth and a hole in the middle
info: a filled black circle with a white lowercase letter i cut out of it
warning: a rounded triangle with an exclamation mark cut out of it
key: an old-fashioned key, round bow with a hole and a toothed blade
history: a simple clock face with an hour and a minute hand
download: a downward arrow onto a tray (download)
laptop: a laptop computer seen from the front, open
pack-engineering: a terminal prompt: a rounded rectangle window with a > chevron and a short underscore cursor cut out of it
pack-product: a pen nib / fountain pen tip pointing down
pack-founder: a rocket ship pointing up and to the right
pack-finance: three rising bar chart columns with an arrow trending up
pack-student: a graduation mortarboard cap with a tassel
chart: a simple bar chart: three vertical rounded bars of different heights standing on a short baseline, middle bar shortest, right bar tallest (statistics)
